transformations.name: fedelismay282_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_1 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_1 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_1 = '')

derived_fields.name: care_management_program
derived_fields.expression: coalesce(concat_ws('|', coalesce(harp_eligible_src_1, ''), coalesce(health_homes_enrolled_src_1, ''), coalesce(health_home_status_src_1, ''), coalesce(health_home_start_date_src_1, ''), coalesce(health_homes_plus_eligible_src_1, ''), coalesce(high_need_status_src_1, ''), coalesce(CAST(in_care_management_with_fidelis_src_1 AS STRING), '')), '')

derived_fields.name: is_zip4
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN parsed_zip4 IS NOT NULL AND parsed_zip4 != '' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END

derived_fields.name: email_type
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN member_email_src_1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'HOME' ELSE NULL END

derived_fields.name: email_type
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN guardian_email_src_1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'GUARDIAN' ELSE NULL END
